scripts.gen: bun scripts/gen.ts --domains 120 --seed 1 && bun fmt src/domains test/generated fixtures
scripts.ci:local: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.timings:update: mkdir -p .ci && bun test --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.ci/junit.xml && bun scripts/timings.ts merge .ci/junit.xml > .ci/test-timings.json
